reason: The monoclinic metric and reduced approximately 260.4 A^3 cell (likely Z=2) are reasonably supported by indexing and systematic absences, but exact structure recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the trace's own approximate full-profile residual is about 0.276 for selected.cif and 0.321 for alternative-1.cif, far above the approximately 0.090 Pawley residual. The selected model came from a random P1 screen followed by a 57-coordinate fit limited to 5-55 degrees that terminated at the evaluation limit, so its nominally better extracted-intensity score is vulnerable to overfitting and does not establish P1 symmetry or the coordinates/order. Its coordination is chemically implausible (several Li/Zn sites have only about two short F neighbors and Ba/K are markedly undercoordinated); the alternative is worse, including approximately 1.52 A Ba-F and 1.51 A Zn-F contacts and a Ba site with no F neighbor below about 3.0 A. The trajectory compared rigid cubic derivatives and random P1/P-1 realizations, but did not instantiate and whole-pattern-refine chemically coherent low-symmetry ordered fluoride frameworks or the relevant symmetry/order variants. A materially different, physically constrained structure can plausibly improve the candidate set, so another attempt is warranted.
